name: packunitvector
text: A unit vector as the axis of its largest component (and the sign of it), and the two other components divided by it: 2 * magnitude + sign.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackunitvector
text: Decode two ratios and the axis of greatest magnitude, then normalize the vector.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: packorientation
text: A unit vector as a path in the octahedron: 3 bits for the octant (face), then 2 bits for each split of the face into 4 triangles (0: at corner 0, 1: at corner 1, 2: at corner 2, 3: the middle one).
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackorientation
text: The reverse of packorientation: the face from the first 3 bits, then each pair of bits picks one of the 4 triangles.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: packangle
text: An angle in radians as bits - 1 bits of size and one sign bit (the top bit).
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackangle
text: An angle in radians from bits - 1 bits of size and a sign bit.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: packposition
text: A position as 3 raw floats.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackposition
text: Read each position component as a separate word.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: packpositiondelta
text: The difference a - b of 3 components as signed numbers in -range..range.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackpositiondelta
text: ref + the difference of packpositiondelta.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: packscalar
text: A number in 0..range as bits - 1 bits of size and one sign bit (the top bit).
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.

name: unpackscalar
text: Read a signed magnitude from the bit stream and scale it to the supplied range.
hint: Join a server, chat, leave, host a game.
